title: Months of Mortgage Insurance Premium in a Rural Home Loans Escrow Projection
content:
**Clause.** In a Rural Home Loans escrow projection, the months of mortgage insurance premium projected are chosen as follows: when mortgage insurance is no longer in force, none are projected; when it is in force and principal is scheduled under the original amortization, the level payment that amortises the original principal over the product's amortization months at the initial note rate rounded to the cent, to reach the product's automatic termination level of original value on a payment due date within the projection, the scheduled balance on a due date being the balance after that due date's payment, the payment being numbered as the amortization months less the whole months from that due date to the maturity date, the premium is projected only for the months whose payment due date is earlier than that date; otherwise it is projected for all twelve months.

## Product figures the clause turns on

| Product | Amortization months | Automatic termination level |
|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 180 | 78 percent of original value |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 240 | 78 percent of original value |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 360 | 78 percent of original value |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 360 | 78 percent of original value |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 360 | 78 percent of original value |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 360 | 0 (mortgage insurance not offered) |

## The scheduled balance in words

- **Level payment:** the payment that amortises the original principal over the amortization months at the initial note rate on the loan record, rounded to the cent.
- **Scheduled balance after a payment:** starting from the original principal, each scheduled payment adds one month's interest at the initial note rate divided by 12 and takes off the level payment, with no rounding along the way.
- **Payment number of a due date:** the amortization months less the whole months from that due date to the maturity date.
- **Termination level amount:** the original value multiplied by the automatic termination level and divided by 100. Principal reaches it when the scheduled balance is at or below it.

## Cases

| Mortgage insurance | Scheduled to reach the level on a due date within the projection | Months projected |
|---|---|---|
| no longer in force | — | none |
| in force | yes | the months whose payment due date is earlier than that due date |
| in force | no | all twelve |

## Worked case (hypothetical loan)

Original principal 200000.00, initial note rate 6.0 percent, 360 amortization months: the level payment is 1199.10. Original value 244000.00 at a level of 78 percent gives 190320.00. The next due date carries payment number 40. Scheduled balances: after payment 40, 191207.97; 41, 190964.91; 42, 190720.64; 43, 190475.14; 44, 190228.42, at or below 190320.00. The premium is projected for the 4 months whose due dates carry payments 40 to 43.
